statement: Whenever can_partition(nums) returns a result r, r = true if and only if there exist sets A and B of indices from {0, 1, ..., len(nums)-1} such that A intersect B is empty, A union B = {0, 1, ..., len(nums)-1}, and sum_{i in A} nums[i] = sum_{i in B} nums[i] (all sums exact integers).
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 200 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: can_partition(nums) returns a result r (a Bool) and does not fail; in particular, no i64 overflow or panic occurs.
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 200 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever can_partition(nums) returns a result r, if T = sum_{i=0}^{len(nums)-1} nums[i] is odd, then r = false.
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 200 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever can_partition(nums) returns a result r, if r = true then for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums) we have 2 * nums[i] <= T, where T = sum_{j=0}^{len(nums)-1} nums[j].
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 200 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever can_partition(nums) returns a result r, if there exists an index i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and 2 * nums[i] = T, where T = sum_{j=0}^{len(nums)-1} nums[j], then r = true.
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 200 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100.

statement: Whenever can_partition(nums) returns a result r, r = false.
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 200 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; additionally len(nums) = 1.

statement: Whenever can_partition(nums) returns a result r, r = true if and only if nums[0] = nums[1].
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 200 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; additionally len(nums) = 2.

statement: Whenever can_partition(nums) returns a result r, r = true if and only if there exists i with 0 <= i < 3 and 2 * nums[i] = T, where T = nums[0] + nums[1] + nums[2].
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 200 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; additionally len(nums) = 3.

statement: Whenever can_partition(nums) returns a result r, r = true if and only if len(nums) is even.
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 200 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; additionally there exists a positive integer c such that nums[i] = c for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: If can_partition(nums) returns a result r and can_partition(perm) returns a result r', then r = r'.
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 200 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; perm is any slice satisfying the same constraints that is a permutation of nums (same multiset of values, possibly different order).

statement: Let nums2 be the slice with nums2[i] = nums[i] / d for 0 <= i < len(nums). If can_partition(nums) returns a result r and can_partition(nums2) returns a result r', then r = r'.
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 200 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; d is a positive integer such that d divides nums[i] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).

statement: Let nums2 be the slice with nums2[i] = c * nums[i] for 0 <= i < len(nums). If can_partition(nums) returns a result r and can_partition(nums2) returns a result r', then r = r'.
preconditions: nums is a slice of 64-bit signed integers with 1 <= len(nums) <= 200 and, for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 100; c is a positive integer such that c * nums[i] <= 100 for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums).
